candidates.publisher: Embodied Agent Arena authors (HKUST Guangzhou / CUHK / Knowin AI)
candidates.title: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
candidates.finding: The authors publish an evaluation harness spanning 1,000 cases from 32 established sources plus GeoProbe, a 168-case geometry suite, across five embodied capabilities. The public repository documents a pinned dataset revision, hash validation, inspectable dry-run planning, checkpoint/resume for evaluation, and offline scoring of saved predictions. The authors' seven-model scores are reported results, not independently reproduced HILO evidence.
candidates.hilo_adaptation: As an advisory, non-ranking HILO integration-method reference, consider pinned benchmark inputs, deterministic source checks, dry-run plans, checkpointable diagnostics and offline scoring of saved predictions. Preserve each case's provenance and distinguish visual/simulation tests, real robot deployment, and longitudinal human evidence. Do not convert benchmark cases or predicted action labels to verified robot hours, voluntary human keep decisions, field-safety claims or certification.
